subject: Post-call: InkWell AI usage review & renewal qualification
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam@inkwell.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: InkWell AI usage review & renewal qualification

Sam — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth. I kept this high level; happy to expand any section.

TL;DR:
- Primary goal: lock in a renewal + reserved capacity for Q4 to cover new RAG and bulk-embedding workloads.
- Current pain: unpredictable tail-latency on larger batch jobs and burst costs when nightly ETL runs kick off.
- Short-term ask: 2-week technical validation to confirm throughput targets, and a draft commercial term for review.

What we discussed (notes):
1) Current usage & baseline
   - Avg tokens/month: ~85M (Q2) with 3% weekly growth; heavy spikes during indexed-search rebuilds (up to ~320M/day).
   - Embedding requests: ~12k/day; latency fine but cost creeping as vector store grows.
2) New workloads on deck
   - Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for customer support triage (high read, moderate write).
   - Batch summarization pipeline for legacy tickets (nightly window, sensitive to tail latency).
3) Pain points & constraints
   - SLA: need 99.9% for production pod, currently experiencing ~20-30s tails on the largest jobs.
   - Compliance: on-premise audit requirements for logs retention for EU customers (may affect Private deployment later).
4) Success metrics we aligned on
   - <200ms median generation latency for interactive flows; sub-2s 95th for embeddings queries at steady state.
   - Reduce per-token cost on batch runs by 25% via batching/caching/quant profiles.

Proposed validation plan (owners & timing):
- Technical validation (Aditya / Redwood Solutions): 2 weeks, start next Mon (2026-07-27). Deliverable: runbook + perf report with profiling on your representative workloads.
- Commercial draft (Lauren / Redwood RevOps): draft MA and committed capacity options by 2026-07-30.
- Tech sync with InkWell infra (Sam / InkWell Ops): 45-min call to share sample logs and agree SLO measurement points — target by 2026-07-23.

Attachments: sending a very small usage snapshot (inkwell_usage_snapshot_q2.csv) and an initial maître d' draft of a commercial outline (MA_plan_draft_v1.pdf) for Lauren to iterate on.

Requests for you:
- Sam: please share a single representative JetStream job ID and a short 10–15 minute snippet of logs from a high-latency run.
- Ops: list the IP ranges and any egress constraints for the validation cluster (if we need Private networking).

Next steps (simple):
1) Sam to confirm availability for the 45-min tech sync (this week).
2) Aditya to spin up validation template and invite the infra/eng folks.
3) Lauren to circulate the initial commercial outline.

If that aligns, I’ll send calendar invites for the tech sync and the start-of-validation kickoff.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

--
